title: Project trap ability checks and dispel DCs; Sphere of Annihilation trap relationships; hazard registry dispositions
description:
Lane A (importer/source-fidelity projection), profile rules-clause-complete. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; pack changes need a thaw note under docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/ (TEMPLATE.md).

ROOT CAUSE: deriveHazardMechanics (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts) projects only saves/damage/conditions. Every printed trap ability check (detect, disarm, escape, pry, slow) and every printed dispel-magic DC is silently dropped, and hazard:sphere-of-annihilation projects nothing (opus:F-23 sphere-prose).

SCOPE (deterministic query, not an example list): every hazard record with data.category 'trap' (and each hazard:pits data.variants entry, projected from that variant's own text only). Within each, every sentence that prints a DC and is not a saving throw. Snapshot at main bfbe47f9 is 21 sentences across collapsing-roof, falling-net, fire-breathing-statue, pits (Simple/Hidden/Locking), poison-darts, poison-needle, rolling-sphere and sphere-of-annihilation. The generated pack is authoritative, not this count. Shapes:
 (1) 'A successful DC N <Ability> (<Skill>) check ...' / 'With a successful DC N <Ability> (<Skill>) check ...' / '... with a DC N <Ability> check ...'
 (2) '... DC N Dexterity check using thieves' tools ...'
 (3) 'The DC to spot X is N.' / 'The DC is N to spot X ...' (no ability printed)
 (4) 'A successful dispel magic (DC N) ...'
Disease/poison sentences (e.g. Cackle Fever's DC drop) are OUT of scope.

REQUIRED PROJECTION (values verbatim from source, never invented):
 - mechanics.checks: [{ dc:number, ability?:lowercase ability, skill?:kebab skill, tool?:'thieves-tools', text:<the exact printed sentence> }]. Omit ability/skill when not printed (shape 3 must NOT invent Perception). Printed order.
 - mechanics.dispels: [{ spell:'spell:dispel-magic', dc:number, text:<exact sentence> }] for shape 4. Resolve the spell key fail-closed against emitted spells.
 - hazard:sphere-of-annihilation additionally:
   (a) mechanics.checks entry for the DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) sentence;
   (b) data.identicalToRef: 'magic-item:sphere-of-annihilation' plus data.identicalToText: the two verbatim sentences ('A successful DC 20 ... can't be controlled or moved.' is the qualifier; 'It is otherwise identical to a normal sphere of annihilation.'), NOT a copied item projection;
   (c) data.versions: [{ text:<the three verbatim sentences starting 'Some versions of the trap include'>, likeSpellRef:'spell:antipathy-sympathy', likeSpellAspect:'sympathy', mechanics:{ dispels:[{spell:'spell:dispel-magic', dc:18, text}] } }]. The DC 18 dispel lives ONLY on the version, not at record level. Do not use data.variants: variants are printed, named alternative sub-traps (hazard:pits); this is an unnamed optional addition.
 - Fail closed: if a DC-bearing non-save trap sentence matches none of the shapes, the importer throws (so a new sibling cannot silently disappear).
 - Declare every new field: fieldProvenanceDeclarations.ts (hazard section near line 877) and record-relationship declarations (reference, record-key) for identicalToRef (relation 'otherwise-identical-to'), versions/*/likeSpellRef (relation 'effect-like-spell'), and the dispels spell fields (relation 'dispelled-by'). Follow the existing declaration source of record-relationships.json; verify nested '*' pointers are supported, and keep every reference resolving (resolveRecordRelationships yields 'resolved').
 - Kind schema: extend validateDnd5eHazard (packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts) only as far as needed to validate the new typed fields if the existing pattern validates mechanics shapes; do not loosen anything.

ENGINE BOUNDARY: projection only. No runtime/state change, no engine hook, no capability claim. Detection/disarm resolution stays DM-adjudicated. Grep hazard mechanics consumers (src/orchestrator, src/state, rule cards) and confirm none breaks.

REGISTRY DISPOSITIONS (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json plus any source it is generated from):
 - sphere-prose (opus:F-23): accepted, statusReasoning naming this repair and its evidence test.
 - hazard-success-branches (opus:F-01): accepted, statusReasoning 'Repaired by PR #567 (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3.1, merge 25631abf); hazards are included in the committed half-damage source census (halfDamageSuccessBranches.test.ts).'
 - hazard-and-healing-potion (sol:CAP-006): narrowed under ADR 0020. No completeness or execution claim. The surviving obligation is that emitted hazard and healing-potion projections agree with source; the healing potion's typed table-driven healing is already projected.
 - hazard-completeness (indep:007): narrowed under ADR 0020. Hazards are not claimed deterministically executable; the surviving obligation is source-faithful hazard projections, including printed checks/dispels (this bead).
Match the existing statusReasoning style (see the pit-variants and damage-field-shape rows).

EVIDENCE (no per-hazard test sprawl): one test file packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/trapChecksProjection.test.ts that:
 - asserts the exact sphere-of-annihilation projection (checks, identicalToRef, versions with dispel DC 18 and the likeSpell ref) and that its relationships resolve;
 - asserts a generalized census: for every trap record/variant, each DC-bearing non-save sentence in its source text appears as exactly one checks/dispels entry whose text equals that sentence and whose dc equals the printed number (derived from the generated pack text, not a hand-copied count);
 - asserts shape 3 entries carry no ability/skill.
Never weaken existing tests or audit expectations.

GENERATED OUTPUTS: regenerate with `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/` then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`; refresh any inventory/pin tests that legitimately change (e.g. srdGeneratedPack pins, field-provenance), explaining each in the thaw note.

NO-REPEAT ALIASES: opus:F-23, opus:F-01, sol:CAP-006, indep:007.

COMPLETION PROOF: `npm run verify:worktree` passes in the child worktree; commit on the assigned branch only (no push, no PR); report the commit SHA and a summary of changed files.
